unit: command -v uv >/dev/null || pipx install uv==0.11.3; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra sqlite --extra codebase && CORTEX_MEMORY_STORE_BACKEND=sqlite CORTEX_RERANKER_OFFLINE=1 uv run --locked pytest --tb=short -q -p no:randomly --cov=mcp_server --cov-report=xml
regression: command -v uv >/dev/null || pipx install uv==0.11.3; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra sqlite --extra codebase && CORTEX_MEMORY_STORE_BACKEND=sqlite CORTEX_RERANKER_OFFLINE=1 uv run --locked pytest --tb=short -q -p no:randomly tests_py/integration
environment: PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)" && "$PY" -m venv "$CI_WORK/venv" && VPY="$CI_WORK/venv/bin/python" && { [ -x "$VPY" ] || VPY="$CI_WORK/venv/Scripts/python.exe"; } && "$VPY" -m pip install --quiet . && "$VPY" -c "from mcp_server.doctor import run; raise SystemExit(run())"
